object.description: Open VCU3-SRS in a window small enough for the grid to scroll. Select VCU3-SRS-15 and scroll the grid halfway down. From the grid, set VCU3-SRS-15's status, then its description. Expected: VCU3-SRS-15 stays selected, the grid's scroll position is the same as before the edits, the grid isn't rebuilt, and the row shows the new values.
